hypotheses.claim: The current libmtmd encode-to-decode gap can host a synchronous zero-copy MVC/open-set gate that materially lowers familiar-state end-to-end cost while preserving task/open-set correctness.
hypotheses.falsifier: No Pareto benefit or unacceptable false-familiar/open-set error on target-VPS matched fixtures.

hypotheses.claim: Global+2x2 spatial pooled descriptors over frozen Qwen projected features preserve enough GUI layout information to outperform global-mean familiarity at small persistent footprint.
hypotheses.falsifier: No held-out/OOD gain over global mean, or tiny projection/dedicated embedder dominates under equal cost.

hypotheses.claim: ROI+context with adaptive token budgets and periodic/on-demand anchors dominates full-frame-every-cycle and changed-tiles-only sensing for Frank GUI workloads.
hypotheses.falsifier: Equal-budget target fixtures show no task/resource gain or materially higher hidden-state/grounding errors.

hypotheses.claim: After calibrated visual identity, a compact provenance-bound PerceptualMemorySeed can seed EAP before full decode and improve context/decision efficiency without increasing confirmation-bias errors.
hypotheses.falsifier: Wrong/stale-seed controls amplify error or direct-memory baseline matches/beat PAR end-to-end.

hypotheses.claim: Frank can make multimodal recovery explicit and safe even when current llama.cpp image-slot persistence is incomplete by binding media/model/mmproj/MVC identities and degrading to re-encode/re-perceive rather than silently reusing stale state.
hypotheses.falsifier: Restart/replay can yield undetected semantic divergence or stale media reuse under declared guards.
